crewTerms.signIn: Sign in to view your applications.
crewTerms.noAgreement: No active approved agreement. Complete recruitment before assigning this member.
nativeApplications.review: Review the displayed terms before confirming this version.
taskWorkbench.episodeQueued: This episode already has a batch in the workbench.
taskWorkbench.episodeStageHelp: Review this episode’s tasks, then stage them in the workbench. Nothing is created until you select Create All Tasks.
taskWorkbench.episodeRetry: Select Create All Tasks to retry this same batch. Previously created tasks will be reused.
canvasImport.title: Import Canvas Tasks
canvasImport.help: Paste a Studio canvas link from this region. Review scenes and stage them; Create All Tasks submits the import.
canvasImport.invalidLink: Use a valid Studio canvas link for this app’s region.
canvasImport.queued: This canvas already has a batch in the workbench.
taskWorkbench.title: Task Creation Workbench
taskWorkbench.help: Stage tasks, review their details, then create them together. Drafts stay in this signed-in session while you switch screens; they are not saved on the server and are lost when the app restarts or you sign out.
taskWorkbench.forgetHelp: Remove this local attempt only. A task may already exist on the server; this does not delete it or retry its creation.
crewInterview.title: Interview
crewInterview.readOnly: This application has been reviewed. Interview history is read-only.
crewInterview.retryHelp: The result is uncertain. Retry the same request before making another change.
crewInterview.sharedNote: This text is visible to both the applicant and reviewers. It does not confirm payment terms.
crewPositionInvites.title: Private recruitment invitations
crewPositionInvites.help: Accepting creates an application. It does not grant Crew membership or task access.
crewPositionInvites.retryHelp: The result is uncertain. Retry the same request before starting another action.
crewPositionInvites.acceptedHelp: Your application is available below. Terms and reviewer approval are still required.
crewPositionInvites.invalid: Choose another user and an expiry from 1 to 30 days.
crewPositionInvites.invalidPortfolio: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS portfolio URL.
inviteManagement.title: Manage Recruitment Invitations
inviteManagement.uncertain: The creation response was not confirmed. Review the refreshed invitation list before creating another invitation.
inviteManagement.saved: Response saved. Refresh to review the latest invitations.
applicationReview.title: Review Applications
applicationReview.approveHelp: Approval may add this creator to the Crew and activate agreed task assignments and compensation. Confirm that you have reviewed their application and final terms.
applicationReview.rejectHelp: Reject this application? The creator will not be admitted through this application.
applicationReview.requirements: Confirmed final terms are required for task recruitment. Resolve pending interviews before approval.
applicationReview.recheck: The decision was not confirmed. Refresh and check the application status before another action.
termsProposal.saved: Proposal Saved. Refresh to See the Latest Confirmation Status.
termsProposal.taskFee: Task recruitment uses a per-project fee, up to 100,000,000 in the displayed currency.
termsProposal.retryHelp: The result is uncertain. Retry sends exactly the same proposal and version.
termsProposal.changed: Terms or access changed. Discard this draft and reload before proposing again.
crewAmendments.title: Post-approval amendments
crewAmendments.boundary: Proposals do not change the current agreement. Confirmation may activate eligible unpaid terms or send the amendment to finance review. Paid reductions require separate settlement; no automatic refund or deduction occurs. Revenue-share terms do not calculate project profit or payments.
crewAmendments.retryHelp: The result is uncertain. Retry the same request before making another change. Recovery is retained only while this panel stays open.
crewAmendments.stale: The agreement or task changed. Discard this draft and review the latest terms before proposing again.
crewAmendments.discard: Discard draft and start from current terms
crewAmendments.historyHelp: Activated history may have been superseded. The current effective agreement is shown above. Awaiting finance and manual-settlement requests are not effective amendments.
nativeAmendments.confirmDecision: Confirm “{action}” for amendment {id}? Review the proposed scope, fee, revenue share and reason above.
nativeAmendments.invalid: Enter a scope, reason of at least three characters, project fee from 0–100,000,000 and share from 0–50%. A nonzero share requires a calculation basis.
positionCreate.title: Create Position
positionCreate.visibilityHelp: Private recruitment requires a linked task. Public positions appear in discovery when the Crew and position are eligible.
positionCreate.saved: Position {id} Created. Return to the Positions List to Review It.
positionCreate.recheck: The result is not confirmed. Return to the refreshed positions list and check for the new role before creating again.
positionCreate.invalid: Check the required description, headcount, location, salary range and currency precision, duration, share and calendar date. Use no more than 20 skills.
positionLifecycle.title: Position Status
positionLifecycle.confirmReopen: Reopen this position? Recruitment still depends on available places and the closing date.
positionLifecycle.confirmRemove: Delete this position? Pending applications must be resolved first.
positionLifecycle.saved: Position updated. Return to the refreshed positions list.
positionLifecycle.recheck: The change could not be confirmed. Return to the refreshed positions list before another action.
positionEdit.title: Edit Position
positionEdit.recheck: Return to the refreshed positions list before another update.
positionEdit.help: Changes apply to this recruitment listing. Existing accepted terms are managed through the amendment workflow.
taskClosure.title: Cancel Task With a Reason
taskClosure.notice: This cancels unfinished work. Assignments, agreed rewards and evidence are preserved. It does not settle payments, refunds or disputes.
taskClosure.required: A written reason is required (up to 4,000 characters).
taskClosure.stale: The task changed. Return to the current task and review it before confirming.
taskClosure.retryHelp: The result is uncertain. Retry the same closure request to check its outcome.
taskClosure.done: Task cancelled. Refresh to load its current status.
taskDelete.title: Delete Task
taskDelete.notice: This removes the task from active lists. Evidence is retained. Subtasks move to the nearest active parent, or become top-level tasks. This does not settle payments or disputes.
taskDelete.recheck: Deletion could not be confirmed. Refresh and review the task before another attempt.
viewEdit.title: Edit Task View
viewEdit.shared: Changes apply to this shared Crew view for everyone.
viewEdit.missing: This task view is no longer available. Return to the list and refresh.
viewEdit.name: View Name
viewEdit.webDisplay: These layout and column settings apply on Web. Mobile keeps its compact task list.
viewEdit.reloadHelp: Reload the latest view before trying again. Reloading discards unsaved edits.
viewEdit.field.title: Title
viewLifecycle.copyHelp: The new shared view copies this view’s filters, sorting, fields and visibility. You can edit its settings after creation.
viewLifecycle.deleteHelp: This removes the shared view for the Crew. Tasks are kept.
viewLifecycle.last: Keep at least one task view.
viewLifecycle.confirmHelp: Confirm deletion of the view named above.
viewLifecycle.recheck: Return to the refreshed view list and check the result before trying again.
taskLabels.title: Manage Task Labels
taskLabels.shared: Labels are shared across this Crew.
taskLabels.name: Label Name
taskLabels.colorHelp: Choose a color or enter a six-digit hex color, such as #e52227.
taskLabels.recheck: Return to the refreshed label list and check the result before trying again.
taskLabels.deleteHelp: Delete “{name}” from this Crew? Its task/project assignments and saved-view filters will be removed. Tasks and projects are kept.
taskCycles.title: Manage Task Cycles
taskCycles.shared: Cycles organize the Crew’s production schedule.
taskCycles.name: Cycle Name
taskCycles.datesHelp: Use YYYY-MM-DD in your local time zone. New dates span the full selected days.
taskCycles.activeHelp: Only one cycle can be active. Complete the current active cycle before starting another.
taskCycles.recheck: Return to the refreshed cycle list and check the result before trying again.
taskCycles.deleteHelp: Delete “{name}”? Tasks are kept, but their cycle links and this cycle’s saved-view filters will be removed.
taskWorkflowManagement.title: Workflow Columns
taskWorkflowManagement.shared: Columns are shared across this Crew. Status controls the task lifecycle and cannot be changed after creation.
taskWorkflowManagement.archiveHelp: Archiving removes this column from the active workflow. Existing tasks move to the selected replacement without changing their workflow status.
taskWorkflowManagement.noReplacement: Create another column with the same workflow status before archiving this column.
taskWorkflowManagement.deleteHelp: Permanently delete this archived column and remove it from saved view filters? Task references, including deleted tasks, prevent deletion.
taskWorkflowManagement.recheck: Return to the column list to refresh and verify the result before trying again.
crewStudio.title: Studio Workspace
crewStudio.help: Link a workspace you administer. Each workspace can be linked to only one Crew.
crewStudio.legacy: Legacy project: {name} · {workspace}. Select its workspace explicitly to update this link.
crewStudio.linkHelp: Replace the current Studio link with the selected workspace? This also clears any legacy project link.
crewStudio.unlinkHelp: Remove the Crew’s Studio link? This clears workspace and legacy project links without deleting the workspace or its contents.
crewStudio.initializeHelp: Create and link a new Studio workspace for this Crew?
crewStudio.recheck: Refresh to verify the current link before trying again.
studioMedia.title: Studio Media
studioMedia.bindHelp: Select one Studio asset to link to this file. The original file contents stay unchanged.
studioMedia.importHelp: Select up to 40 assets. Media already present in this folder is skipped.
studioMedia.noWorkspace: Link a Studio workspace to this Crew first.
studioMedia.confirmHelp: Apply the selected Studio media to this destination?
studioMedia.unlinkHelp: Remove the Studio association while keeping this file and its contents?
studioMedia.recheck: Refresh and review the asset state before trying again.
assetOrganization.title: Organize Assets
assetOrganization.name: Name
assetOrganization.keepParent: Keep the current folder unless you choose another destination.
assetOrganization.confirmHelp: Save this name and destination? Moving a folder also moves its contents and may change inherited access.
assetOrganization.recheck: Refresh and review the asset before trying again.
assetLifecycle.trashHelp: Move this asset to Trash? A folder’s active contents are moved with it. You can restore it later.
assetLifecycle.restoreHelp: Restore this asset to its original folder. Contents trashed together with a folder are restored with it; previously trashed items remain in Trash.
assetLifecycle.deleteHelp: Permanently delete this asset and its folder contents? This cannot be undone. Unreferenced Crew uploads may also be removed from storage.
assetLifecycle.name: Asset Name Confirmation
assetLifecycle.recheck: Go back and refresh the asset state before trying again.
assetPermissions.title: Asset Permissions
assetPermissions.inheritHelp: Use the parent folder or Crew permissions. Explicit grants will be cleared when saved.
assetPermissions.restrictedHelp: Grant access to active Crew members. Crew asset administrators retain access. Folder permissions also affect inheriting descendants.
assetPermissions.retained: Your delegated Manage access will be retained when saving restricted permissions.
assetPermissions.inactive: No longer an active member. Remove this grant before saving restricted access.
assetPermissions.confirmHelp: Confirm these access changes? They may change who can open this asset and its inheriting descendants.
assetOrganization.sort.name: Name A–Z
assetUpload.help: Select a file to upload, then confirm adding it to this folder. The server may adjust its name to avoid duplicates.
assetUpload.retryHelp: Retry uses the same uploaded file. If the destination changed, return to the refreshed asset list to check the result.
assetUpload.leaveHelp: Leaving before adding the file abandons this draft. Unattached uploads are cleaned up by the server.
crewMembers.title: Crew Members
crewMembers.removeHelp: This revokes the member’s Crew collaboration and chat access and releases their recruited positions. Review the selected person before confirming.
crewMembers.ownerProtected: Transfer ownership before removing the Crew owner.
crewMembers.confirmId: Type the Member’s User ID to Confirm
crewMembers.removeRecheck: Return to the refreshed member directory to check the result before taking another action.
memberPositions.title: Edit Member Positions
memberPositions.help: Assign up to 12 positions. The first is primary. Positions do not grant management or finance access.
memberPositions.invalid: Choose a standard position or enter a custom title for every row.
memberPositions.confirmHelp: Confirm these position changes? Removing a recruited position may release its vacancy. Clearing all positions keeps the person as a Crew member.
memberAccess.title: Edit Member Access
memberAccess.help: Choose a management and finance access combination. Individual permission overrides remain in effect.
memberAccess.confirmHelp: Confirm the selected access for this member.
memberAccess.recheck: Return to the directory and refresh before another attempt.
memberAccess.ownerProtected: The Crew owner already has every permission.
crewTransfer.title: Transfer Crew Ownership
crewTransfer.help: The selected active member will become the Crew owner. You will lose owner-only access; your existing member policies still apply if you stay.
crewTransfer.leaveHelp: Leaving removes your Crew membership and associated collaboration/chat access, and releases recruited positions.
crewTransfer.protected: Choose another active member as the new owner.
crewTransfer.recheck: The transfer may have completed. Return and refresh before another attempt.
projectProperties.title: Project Properties
projectProperties.readOnly: You can view this project. Management permission is required to edit it.
projectProperties.dateHelp: Leave dates blank to clear them. For month, quarter, half-year or year, enter the first day of that period.
projectProperties.confirmHelp: Review the selected project properties before saving.
projectResources.title: Project Resources
projectResources.name: Resource Title
projectResources.confirmHelp: Review the resource before adding it to the project.
projectResources.recheck: The change may have completed. Return and refresh before another attempt.
projectResources.removeHelp: Remove this reference from the project? The original file will remain in the Asset Center.
projectDocument.title: Project Overview
projectDocument.readOnly: Read-only document. Tap a link to open it.
projectDocument.loadError: The document could not be displayed. Refresh to try again.
projectDocument.linkOpenError: The link could not be opened on this device.
documentEditor.title: Edit Project Overview
documentEditor.invalid: Check the content or input format.
projectDocument.save.busy: A save is already in progress.
projectDocument.save.uncertain: Save status is uncertain. Return and refresh before editing again.
projectDocument.save.permission: You no longer have permission to edit this document.
projectDocument.save.changed: This document changed. Return and refresh before editing again.
projectDocument.save.receipt: The save could not be confirmed. Return and refresh to check the document.
projectDocument.save.session: Your account session changed. Reopen the document.

crewComputeFinance.projectBudgetClosed: Project compute is closed for producer settlement.
crewComputeFinance.producerDeduction: FD Admin-approved producer deduction: {amount} minor units ({currency})
crewComputeFinance.creator: Creator
crewComputeFinance.ownerOnly: Only the project owner can request compute points. Ask the owner to link the workspace and request points for your task.
crewComputeFinance.workspaceRequired: Set up the project compute workspace before requesting points. This creates or reuses its accounting workspace; it does not add points or move Studio projects.
crewComputeFinance.topUpPolicy: One top-up application per task, up to 500 points. Describe the remaining workload. Approval adds points to the linked workspace.
crewComputeFinance.topUpAlreadyApplied: This task already has a top-up application. Check its decision in Finance.
crewComputeFinance.assignFirst: Assign a creator to this task before requesting a top-up.
